units.source_text: 擦完后，轮到女人擦拭男人的身体。

en.t: After she finished wiping herself, it was the woman's turn to wipe the man's body.

units.source_text: 男人闭上眼睛，轻柔地抚摸着女人的头发等待着。

en.t: The man closed his eyes and waited, gently stroking the woman's hair.

units.source_text: 头发是干巴巴，一点也不光滑。

en.t: Her hair was dry and brittle, not smooth at all.
